run_document_tokenizer_merger: run the DocumentTokenizerMerger pipeline step to merge and shuffle tokenized files into output files
create_document_tokenizer_merger: create a DocumentTokenizerMerger instance with input and output folders and a save filename for merging tokenized documents
shuffle_tokenized_documents: shuffle tokenized documents across multiple input files and merge them into sequentially numbered output files
load_document_ends: load document end boundaries from a binary index file as a numpy array of token positions
get_data_reader_generator: get a generator that yields binary data chunks for each document given a file and document end boundaries
